title: Centre offers HPC talks after hill council polls, says LAB

ai.summary: Ladakh representatives demand postponement of hill council elections to ensure proper voter registration and participation, as the Centre offers high-powered talks after the elections.

facts.claim: The Centre is understood to be willing to hold high-powered committee-level talks with Ladakh representatives between December 5 and 10, immediately after the December 4 hill council elections
facts.quote: Leh Apex Body (LAB) chairman Chering Dorje Lakruk said.

facts.claim: Lakruk expressed apprehensions over the timing of the hill council elections, alleging that the government may be seeking to weaken the region's collective leadership ahead of crucial negotiations
facts.quote: he expressed apprehensions over the timing of the hill council elections, alleging that the government may be seeking to weaken the region's collective leadership ahead of crucial negotiations.

facts.claim: Lakruk said unofficial channels had conveyed the Centre's readiness to resume negotiations between December 5 and 10
facts.quote: unofficial channels had conveyed the Centre's readiness to resume negotiations between December 5 and 10.

facts.claim: Lakruk questioned the government's insistence on going ahead with the December 4 election despite repeated demands for its deferment
facts.quote: he questioned the government's insistence on going ahead with the December 4 election despite repeated demands for its deferment

facts.claim: Lakruk alleged that the move could be a ploy to have its preferred representatives participate in the proposed talks and weaken the LAB and KDA
facts.quote: alleging that the move could be a ploy to have its preferred representatives participate in the proposed talks and weaken the LAB and KDA

facts.claim: Lakruk claimed serious discrepancies in the electoral rolls, including large-scale deletions, exclusion of Generation Z voters, and inclusion of deceased individuals
facts.quote: He also claimed serious discrepancies in the electoral rolls. He alleged large-scale deletions, "exclusion of a significant number of Generation Z voters" and the inclusion of names of people who had died.

facts.claim: Lakruk said holding elections without correcting these discrepancies would undermine the credibility and representativeness of the exercise
facts.quote: He said holding elections without correcting these discrepancies would undermine the credibility and representativeness of the exercise.

facts.claim: Lakruk stated that the demand for poll postponement was aimed at ensuring that every eligible voter, particularly young voters, gets an opportunity to exercise their democratic right
facts.quote: The LAB chairman maintained that the demand for poll postponement was aimed at ensuring that every eligible voter, particularly young voters, gets an opportunity to exercise their democratic right.

facts.claim: Lakruk said the agitation has received support from outside the Union Territory, with Jharkhand's Tribal Affairs Minister visiting the protest site to express solidarity
facts.quote: He said the agitation has also received support from outside the Union Territory, with Jharkhand's Tribal Affairs Minister visiting the protest site to express solidarity with the demonstrators.

ai.background_note: Ladakh's leadership demands postponement of hill council elections to address electoral roll discrepancies and ensure voter participation, while the Centre offers high-powered talks after the elections.
